completion_rule: Every canonical operation must have only rust_native promoted slices or explicit bridge/reference boundaries with stable unsupported-native behavior.

operation_gaps.required_closure: Keep schema, manifest, and binding-smoke evidence current when discovery metadata changes.
Stable deterministic fit payloads are promoted; covariate, event, custom fitter, probabilistic, and uncertainty-aware payloads remain explicit Python boundaries.

bridge_or_reference_boundaries: custom prediction horizons that require Python model internals
operation_gaps.required_closure: Stable deterministic fitted-state prediction slices are promoted; unsupported model-family and Python-internal payloads remain explicit bridge boundaries.

bridge_or_reference_boundaries: stochastic payloads without stable seed contract
operation_gaps.required_closure: Stable deterministic fitted-state simulation slices are promoted; stochastic and Python-internal payloads remain explicit bridge boundaries.

bridge_or_reference_boundaries: summary payloads that depend on Python-only model internals
operation_gaps.required_closure: Promote deterministic fitted-state reporting slices after schema and memory evidence are complete.

bridge_or_reference_boundaries: diagnostic payloads that depend on Python-only model internals
operation_gaps.required_closure: Promote deterministic fitted-state diagnostic slices after parity, error mapping, benchmark, memory, and binding-smoke evidence are complete.

intentional_python_reference_boundary.reason: Python probabilistic runtimes and Python object internals remain authoritative until their payload contracts are explicitly promoted elsewhere.
